title: Affine restriction of a reduced preparation
statement: Let f:X → T be any scheme morphism, V an open of T, S an integral affine scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], Z a reduced affine scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme], q:S → V and h:Z → X ×_T S [def-pc-fibre-product] universal homeomorphisms [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. Write g:Z → S for the composite with the projection and S → T for q followed by V → T. Let W be an open of S on which the restricted g is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Given a point η₀ in W and its image η in T, there exist an affine open U of T containing η, integral affine S′, reduced affine Z′, and universal homeomorphisms q′:S′ → U and h′:Z′ → X ×_T S′ such that the composite Z′ → S′ is flat and locally finitely presented. No finite type condition on f or generic-point condition is needed.

source.place: Tag 0559, second proof, generic-flat shrinking; Tag 01IT

proof.text: The image of W under the homeomorphism q and the open inclusion V → T is open and contains η. Choose an affine open U contained in that image. Put A = (S → T) inverse U. Since q is affine, A is affine, and since it contains η₀ it is a nonempty open of integral S, hence integral. Restrict Z to g inverse A; this is reduced and affine because g is a map between affine schemes.

The restricted q is a base change of q along U → V. Pullback pasting identifies the target of the restricted h with X ×_T A, making the new h a base change of h. Universal homeomorphisms are stable under base change. Since A is contained in W, further restriction of the flat and locally finitely presented g over W supplies the two properties; the restriction-of-restriction isomorphism identifies this map with g restricted to A.

proof_origin.note: Concrete construction and restriction argument, including pullback comparisons; generic flatness is applied separately in the parent module.

theorem exists_affine_preparation_restriction
    {X T S Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    (V : T.Opens) (q : S ⟶ V.toScheme)
    (h : Z ⟶ pullback f (q ≫ V.ι))
    [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S] [IsAffine Z] [IsReduced Z]
    [IsUniversalHomeomorphism q] [IsUniversalHomeomorphism h]
    (W : S.Opens) (hflat : Flat ((h ≫ pullback.snd f (q ≫ V.ι)) ∣_ W))
    (hfp : LocallyOfFinitePresentation ((h ≫ pullback.snd f (q ≫ V.ι)) ∣_ W))
    (η₀ : S) (hη₀W : η₀ ∈ W) (η : T) (he : (q ≫ V.ι) η₀ = η) :
    ∃ (U : T.Opens), η ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ (S' Z' : Scheme.{u}) (q' : S' ⟶ U.toScheme)
        (h' : Z' ⟶ pullback f (q' ≫ U.ι)),
        IsAffine S' ∧ IsIntegral S' ∧ IsAffine Z' ∧ IsReduced Z' ∧
        IsUniversalHomeomorphism q' ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism h' ∧
        Flat (h' ≫ pullback.snd f (q' ≫ U.ι)) ∧
        LocallyOfFinitePresentation (h' ≫ pullback.snd f (q' ≫ U.ι))
